Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

I am writing to share some feedback regarding recent interactions in the workplace. We have received several reports suggesting that your behavior has not aligned with our company’s core values.

We value a respectful and professional environment for everyone, and we believe that addressing this matter promptly is important for maintaining that standard. We are confident in your ability to make the necessary adjustments and are here to support you in this process.

Please take some time to reflect on this feedback and ensure that your future conduct reflects our professional standards. We look forward to seeing an immediate improvement.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
